resolution: InstantMesh OOM persisted at the EXACT same 15.00 GiB — deterministic identical number = grid_res was still 128 (the config edit hadn't been applied; the setup script's auto-sed only runs on fresh install, not the user's existing clone). Gave the user a foolproof sed+grep to force grid_res:64 in configs/instant-mesh-large.yaml and verify it. Also answered their texmap question: drop --export_texmap (it's the texture/paint bake — unneeded since they paint in Studio), though it's NOT the OOM cause (the crash is geometry extraction, before texturing; only grid_res fixes that). Offered a fallback: if grid_res:64 still OOMs, a source patch to chunk the synthesizer_mesh.py index_select so full-res 128 fits 12GB. No new commit (script already carries the sed for fresh installs).
